journal: International Journal of Greenhouse Gas Control 47, 63-70
experimental_method: In situ Raman spectroscopy with immersion probes in a 2 L autoclave (IMAGES device); Raman intensity ratio calibrated at 100 C against the Duan and Sun (2003) model, then applied at 65 C (CO2 solubility, aqueous phase) and at 100 C (water content of CO2-rich phase).
uncertainties_stated: Pressure +-0.2 bar; temperature +-0.1 C; solubility u at 95% confidence per row; model uncertainty 7% (Duan and Sun).
quality_remarks: Both tables are Raman-derived and rely on calibration to the Duan and Sun EOS, so they are not independent of that model; the authors call the Table 2 values 'calculated from the fit in Fig. 7a'. Table 2 scatter large (u up to 38 permil at 11.7 bar). Individual raw data points not tabulated, only means.
extraction_notes: Text layer clean; all cells compared to images with no corrections. Sanity: Table 1 m increases monotonically with P; Table 2 y_H2O falls with P, minimum ~21 permil near 105 bar. Lines in CSV: first header cell units kept; permil written as 'permil'.
needs_pass2_reason: text layer clean, every cell matched image
pass2_diff: token diff: 212 numbers per pass, identical
